issues.title: Epic: Estate and ways of working
issues.body:
Finish the ten Contoso systems and set up how the team works: board, branch protection, CI, Terraform state, OIDC.

Stories: CU-2 to CU-8.

issues.title: Protect main and run CI on every pull request
issues.story:
As an integration engineer
I want every change to go through a pull request with automated checks
so that main is always deployable and nothing is merged untested.
acceptance: Branch protection on `main`: pull request required, CI check required, no direct pushes
CI workflow runs lint and unit tests on every pull request
A deliberately failing test blocks the merge (prove it once, then fix it)
PR template appears when opening a pull request

issues.title: Bootstrap Terraform remote state in Azure Storage
issues.story:
As an integration engineer
I want Terraform state stored centrally with locking
so that pipelines and I always work from the same, safe state.
acceptance: Storage account and `tfstate` container exist in `rg-contoso-tfstate`
Public blob access disabled; versioning and soft delete on
Access by Entra ID (no storage keys in pipelines)
State key per environment: `dev.tfstate`, `test.tfstate`, `prod.tfstate`

issues.title: GitHub Actions signs in to Azure with OIDC (no stored secrets)
issues.story:
As an integration engineer
I want pipelines to authenticate to Azure with short-lived OIDC tokens
so that no Azure passwords or keys are stored in GitHub.
acceptance: Entra app registration with federated credentials for the `dev`, `test` and `prod` GitHub environments and for pull requests
GitHub environments `dev`, `test`, `prod` exist; `prod` has a required reviewer
A workflow run on `dev` can run `az account show` successfully
No client secret exists on the app registration

issues.title: CRM: Dataverse with the Education Accelerator, loaded with programmes and applicants
issues.story:
As admissions
I want a CRM holding our programmes and applicants
so that recruitment can track every applicant in one place.
acceptance: Free test Microsoft tenant and a Power Apps Developer environment exist (not the Derby tenant)
Education Accelerator installed
Programmes loaded from `reference/code_map.csv` with their CRM codes
A sample of applicants loaded with `applicationId` as an alternate key
Three retired programmes still open in the CRM (the deliberate drift)

issues.title: Moodle running locally with courses for each programme
issues.story:
As a student
I want my modules to appear in Moodle when I enrol
so that I can start learning on day one.
acceptance: Moodle runs in Docker on the laptop (on its own, to save memory)
Web services enabled with a token for an integration user
A course exists per programme (or a sample of programmes)
`core_user_create_users` and `enrol_manual_enrol_users` can be called with the token

issues.title: Identity and Microsoft 365 in the test tenant
issues.story:
As the integration platform
I want an identity for each integration and access to Microsoft 365
so that we can send applicants emails and alert admissions in Teams.
acceptance: Admissions mailbox and a Teams team with an Admissions channel exist (or the closest option available in the tenant)
App registration for Graph with only the permissions needed (least privilege)
A test email can be sent through Graph
Notes on what is real and what is simulated if Microsoft 365 isn't available

issues.title: Sprint 0 review and retrospective
issues.story:
As the team
I want to review what we built and how we worked
so that Sprint 1 starts from a clear, agreed plan.
acceptance: Demo: every estate system reachable and seeded
Retro entry written in `backlog/retros.md`
Sprint 1 stories refined and estimated

issues.title: Epic: Applicant portal to CRM
issues.body:
Every application submitted on the portal appears in the CRM within a minute, exactly once, even if the CRM is down for hours.

Stories: CU-10 to CU-15.

issues.title: Replace the vendor deployment script with Terraform
issues.story:
As an integration engineer
I want the vendor systems defined in Terraform
so that every environment is repeatable and reviewed as code.
acceptance: Terraform module for a container app; vendors deployed from it
`terraform plan` shows no changes after import or recreate
`deploy/deploy-vendors.sh` retired

issues.title: Receive portal webhooks and queue them (Python Function)
issues.story:
As admissions
I want every submitted application captured immediately
so that none are lost, even when the CRM is unavailable.
acceptance: HTTP-triggered Python Function verifies the webhook signature and rejects invalid or old ones
Valid events are put on a Service Bus queue and the Function returns 200 within 1 second
Duplicate events (same event ID) are not queued twice
Unit tests for signature verification

issues.title: Upsert applicants into the CRM (C# worker)
issues.story:
As admissions
I want each application to create or update one CRM record
so that we never see duplicate applicants.
acceptance: C# Function triggered by the Service Bus queue fetches the full application from the portal API
Upserts into Dataverse using `applicationId` as the alternate key
Handles Dataverse 429 throttling with Retry-After
Permanent failures go to the dead-letter queue with a reason
Unit tests for the mapping

issues.title: CD pipeline: dev on merge, ephemeral test and approved prod on release
issues.story:
As an integration engineer
I want deployments to be automatic and gated
so that only tested changes reach production.
acceptance: Merge to `main` deploys to dev
A `v*` tag creates a test environment, runs integration tests, destroys it
Prod deploy waits for approval in the `prod` environment
The same build artefact is deployed to every environment

issues.title: Trace one application end to end
issues.story:
As support
I want to follow one application through every component
so that I can find where it failed in minutes.
acceptance: Application Insights connected to both Functions
A correlation ID from the webhook carried through Service Bus to the CRM write
A saved KQL query shows one application's journey
An alert fires when the dead-letter queue is not empty

issues.title: Sprint 1 review and retrospective
issues.story:
As the team
I want to review, improve and capture what we learned
so that the next sprint goes better.
acceptance: Demo of an application flowing portal to CRM
Retro entry written
Post-incident review written for every incident handled this sprint

issues.title: Nightly finance export into Azure SQL with Data Factory
issues.story:
As finance and admissions
I want last night's finance export loaded into the integration database every morning
so that fee balances can be checked against students without anyone handling files.
acceptance: The finance export (Windows-1252 CSV) is uploaded to a Blob container each night
A Data Factory pipeline copies it into a staging table in Azure SQL, decoding Windows-1252 and UK dates correctly
A stored procedure merges staging into the main table (upsert) and records row counts
A schedule trigger runs it nightly; a failed run raises an alert
Data Factory defined in Terraform; pipeline JSON in Git

issues.title: Reach the on-premises SIS from Azure only through the APIM self-hosted gateway
issues.story:
As the university's security team
I want the student record system reachable from Azure without opening our firewall
so that on-premises systems stay off the public internet.
acceptance: APIM self-hosted gateway runs in Docker on the laptop and connects outwards to APIM
The SIS SOAP service is published in APIM (imported from its WSDL) and called through the gateway
The SIS port is not exposed to the internet
Gateway health and request logs visible in Azure

issues.title: Read-only reporting views on the SIS database
issues.story:
As the integration team
I want read-only reporting views agreed with the student records team
so that bulk reads don't go through slow one-at-a-time SOAP calls.
acceptance: Views for current students and routes, with a read-only database user
The integration user cannot read the base tables or write anything
Documented as an agreed interface, like a real system team would provide

issues.title: Optional: move the SIS database to Oracle Database Free
issues.story:
As an integration engineer
I want the SIS on Oracle, like most real student record systems
so that I practise Oracle SQL and connectivity.
acceptance: Oracle Free runs in Docker (alone, for memory)
SIS seeds and runs against Oracle
Notes on the differences from PostgreSQL met along the way
